entries.01e20ef59aafe9d2: The Fresh Flower Altar Business produces and sets up fresh-flower altars and flower offerings for funerals, and the Bridal Flower Business produces and sells venue flower arrangements and bouquets for weddings. In the Fresh Flower Wholesale Business, fresh flowers purchased from domestic and overseas producers and wholesale markets are sold to fresh-flower retailers and funeral-related companies.
entries.081fac27f05c3e54: This is a category of businesses that are not included in reportable segments. It runs the Funeral Consulting Business, which handles planning and consulting for weddings and funerals, a continuous employment support business, agriculture, a restaurant business, and the manufacture and sale of fertilizer. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥452 million.
entries.110140d43221e137: Its strength lies in having both a business that creates fresh-flower altars and floral arrangements and a wholesale business that buys and sells fresh flowers. Consumer-side information obtained through the altar business and other operations is passed to the wholesale business and provided to producers, linking to direct purchases from producers. Information on production areas and markets obtained by the wholesale business is used in cost management for product development. The wholesale business also holds buying rights contracts with central and local wholesale markets across the country, securing multiple supply routes.
entries.14e2d12dc563b7dc: Funeral-related companies and wedding venues are the main customers
entries.152c603c50e8c93d: This is a business that procures fresh flowers from producers, wholesale markets and wholesalers in Japan and overseas, and sells them to fresh flower retailers and funeral-related companies; it also handles the procurement of fresh flowers used in the Fresh Flower Altar Business. It has bidding-right contracts with wholesale markets across the country, and at overseas production areas its employees provide production guidance and quality control, and it also imports directly. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,516 million, and this is handled by consolidated subsidiary My Sakusesu Co., Ltd.
entries.157bc1af2b016da5: Fresh-flower products for ceremonial occasions and fresh-flower wholesale
entries.18cce0cba6a6ee48: Headquartered in Minami Ward, Kumamoto City, Kumamoto Prefecture, the company and nine consolidated subsidiaries form the group. It runs the Fresh Flower Altar Business, the Fresh Flower Wholesale Business and the Bridal Flower Arrangement Business, and the number of employees for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was 248. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.205a414f3495f106: Wedding venues (hotels, specialized wedding halls, guest houses, restaurants)
entries.22ed37162ddc80c0: Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥7,302 million (down 3.9% year on year). By business, the Fresh Flower Altar Business accounted for ¥4,015 million, the Fresh Flower Wholesale Business ¥2,516 million, the Bridal Flower Business ¥317 million, and Other ¥452 million. Revenue from the newly added fertilizer manufacturing and sales business was offset by a decline in revenue due to the transfer of the systems development business.

entries.5e61ff445ca57ddf: As the basic policy of its medium-term management plan, the company cites strengthening group earnings power under its new structure (holdings structure) and raising corporate value through the promotion of sustainability management. Priority targets are strengthening the management base, expanding sales in each business, and promoting sustainability management and enhancing corporate value; the company states that in the Fresh Flower Altar Business it will strategically expand existing business areas, including through M&A, and develop new products, in the Fresh Flower Wholesale Business it will develop new products and new production regions, and in the Bridal Flower Business it will acquire new customers in the Kansai and Kyushu areas.

entries.c78bf18f69f1f9ce: This is a business that produces fresh flowers used in funerals, such as fresh flower altars and kuge, for funeral-related companies, and sells them including their installation. Its strengths lie in design that responds to the requests of the bereaved family, such as proposals for original altars reflecting the tastes and personality of the deceased and standardized low-priced fresh flower altars. It has bases across the country, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥4,015 million.
